notes.title: Re:night Demo is Now Live! Combat Leaderboard Now Open
notes.content:
[p align="start"]Hello everyone![/p][p align="start"]The playable demo is now available! The combat leaderboard is officially open. This leaderboard event will run until [b]October 22, 2025, at 00:00 (UTC)[/b]. Before the deadline, players' clearance scores will be calculated upon completing the game, and top-ranking players will receive rewards.[/p][p align="start"]🏆 [b]Top 10 Players[/b] – Will receive one activation code for the full version of [i]Re:night[/i]
🏆 [b]Top 50 Players[/b] – Will be featured in the [i]Re:night[/i] 1.0 version's "Outstanding Contributors" list[/p][p align="start"]🎁 [b]Prize Distribution[/b]
After the event concludes, the list of winners and instructions for claiming rewards will be announced via in-game Steam announcements.[/p][p align="start"]⚠️ [b]Important Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Please ensure a stable internet connection to avoid score upload failures.[/p][/*][*][p]If any form of cheating is detected (e.g., using third-party software, modifying game data, exploiting bugs, etc.), the player will be permanently disqualified from the event.[/p][/*][*][p]Inappropriate game IDs (e.g., those containing sensitive content or violating community guidelines) will be censored.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We hope players unleash their creativity and have fun!
The game developer reserves the final right of interpretation.[/p][p align="start"][i]For detailed ranking rules, please refer to the in-game information.[/i][/p]
